unsaid.decision: What to do when GARS's pre-submission check refuses the job
unsaid.goes_wrong: Before a job is queued, the executor checks the dataset's class, purpose and route (the venue rules) and refuses a duplicate. The router's Definitions say to report every refusal and stop, but the sub-stage's submit step says only to capture job_id and the next step announces 'Submitted as job <job_id>' with no branch for exit 1 or 2; the model either announces a submission that did not happen, or changes the executor or memory settings itself to get past the refusal
unsaid.why_rank: A setting changed without the user, or a false 'submitted'; the next STATUS read shows nothing was queued
unsaid.fix: Branch on submit's exit: 1 or 2 sends the failure template with the refusal verbatim and stops; settings change only on the user's word
